description: One project, board or item in full, by the id search returned (project:<id>, board:<projectId>:<boardId>, item:<projectId>:<boardId>:<itemId>) or by an app URL path. Returns { id, title, text, url, metadata }, the ChatGPT fetch contract; text is the record as JSON.

id.description: An id from search, or an app URL path such as /projects/…/boards/…/items/…

organizationId.description: Only needed for project ids when the credential has no default organization; otherwise resolved automatically

name: fetch
